title: Assess Sandbox Application Readiness
description: Assesses a regulatory sandbox application against a declared regulator profile: the applicant declares per-criterion status (met, partially_met, not_met) with evidence refs, requested test parameters (duration, customer cap, per-customer and aggregate value caps, eligible customer types), the four common safeguards (consumer redress, AML/CFT controls, data protection, disclosure to participants) and the exit plan. Returns READY, READY_WITH_GAPS or NOT_ELIGIBLE with sorted gaps, parameter breaches against profile caps, missing safeguards and per-item source cites. Profiles are data: generic (jurisdiction-neutral rubric; its only number is this tool's own disclosed 250-customer default) and cbob (Central Bank of The Bahamas Guidance Note for Participation in the Regulatory Sandbox Framework, issued 8 October 2026: 12-month testing cap at paragraph 28; customer, transaction and cash limits are set per application by ORSAC, so the profile asserts no number there). A cap the pinned source does not fix is null and is never invented. The BMA profile is not shipped: the AI Payments Hub remained consultation-stage at authoring. Any mandatory criterion not_met or a missing exit plan gives NOT_ELIGIBLE. Unknown profile, unknown criterion id and invalid status are refused by name. Synthetic values only; zero network; zero PII.

profile.description: Regulator profile. generic is the jurisdiction-neutral rubric (its only number is this tool's own disclosed 250-customer default); cbob is the pinned Central Bank of The Bahamas Regulatory Sandbox Guidance Note (issued 8 October 2026).

criteria.description: Declared per-criterion status. Unknown criterion ids and invalid statuses are refused.

duration_months.description: Requested testing duration in months. cbob cap 12 (Guidance Note para 28).

customer_cap.description: Requested maximum participating customers. cbob sets limits per application (paras 17 v, 25, 27); the generic profile carries this tool's own disclosed 250 default.

value_cap_per_customer.description: Optional requested per-customer transaction threshold; cbob sets thresholds per application.

aggregate_value_cap.description: Optional requested aggregate/cash holding limit; cbob sets limits per application.

eligible_customer_types.description: Requested customer types, e.g. retail, sme.

safeguards.description: The four common safeguards; each must declare present true or it is reported missing.

customer_transition.description: Synthetic description of how customers transition at exit.

exit_plan.description: A missing exit plan gives NOT_ELIGIBLE (Guidance Note paras 17 xii and 18 iv).

profile_cites.label: Central Bank of The Bahamas — Regulatory Sandbox Framework (Guidance Note issued 8 Oct 2026)

criteria.innovation: CBOB Guidance Note ¶18 i — innovation beneficial to The Bahamas, potential to promote financial inclusion
criteria.consumer_benefit: CBOB Guidance Note ¶13 ii — enhance accessibility, efficiency, security and quality; broaden financial inclusion
criteria.benchmarking_viability: CBOB Guidance Note ¶13 iii — benchmarking and impact assessments demonstrating usefulness, functionality and viability
criteria.resources: CBOB Guidance Note ¶13 iv — financial, human and technical resources sufficient to mitigate consumer risks
criteria.customer_risk: CBOB Guidance Note ¶13 v — capacity of the technology to adversely impact customers or financial stability
criteria.legal_compatibility: CBOB Guidance Note ¶13 vi — compatibility with existing laws, regulations and Central Bank policies; treated as mandatory because a wholesale incompatibility is what the pre-application feedback stage (¶16 iii) screens out

caps.duration_months: CBOB Guidance Note ¶28 — the proposed testing stage may not exceed 12 months
caps.customer_cap: CBOB Guidance Note ¶¶17 v, 25, 27 — customer limits are set per application by ORSAC; the source fixes no numeric cap, so none is asserted
caps.value_cap_per_customer: CBOB Guidance Note ¶¶17 v, 27 v — transaction thresholds are set per application by ORSAC; no numeric cap fixed
caps.aggregate_value_cap: CBOB Guidance Note ¶¶17 v, 27 v — cash holding limits are set per application by ORSAC; no numeric cap fixed

profile_cites.safeguards: CBOB Guidance Note ¶19 iii–vi — data protection, informed consent and disclosure, customer redress; ¶12 v / ¶35 iii — AML/CFT
profile_cites.exit_plan: CBOB Guidance Note ¶17 xii — application must include an exit-plan assessment; ¶18 iv — ORSAC evaluates the exit strategy; ¶45 — exit mechanics
